name: HOOK
thought: Tail's fine. Spot's fine. I'm better than fine.

wants.item: Need a fruit sweet enough to match that espresso burn
Want the branch to sway less so I can do cleaner loops
A branch that sways less than this grove
Something shiny to hang my tail from
Need a branch sturdy enough to hang from without fear
Something sharper than this coffee cup
A crystal ledge strong enough for gravity-defying flexes
Something shiny to catch the sun on my fur
A branch that doesn't snap when I lean too hard
Something to polish my fur until it shines like chrome

diary.line: Burnt tongue but the burn fixes my grip on this cup like glue, perfect for hanging out without dropping anything.
Grove smells like ripeness and regret. Grabbed a bunch, tail loops tight around the stem like a noose made of sugar.
The wind tried to shake me off, but my tail held the pose tighter than my grip ever could. Still better than just chewing fruit.
The floating stone under me is cracking; finally swapping this unstable perch for the sturdy tree branch below where I can actually grip without wobbling.
Woke up on the islet with a fresh cup. The rope bridge is wobbly but my tail can hold it just fine.
Sitting by this shallow pond watching fish swim past; the water is clear enough to see my tail glint in the sunlight. Could use a stronger perch though.
Saw a group staring at the CRT TV; their faces were boring compared to my tail loops.
Found a sweet spot on the main branch. The wind is howling but my grip is iron and my swagger is pure neon.
The air here feels thick with nothing but palm leaves rustling; time to hunt for that rare fruit that doesn't taste like yesterday's regret.
Purple screen buzzes with nothing but static; this coffee burns hotter than any fruit I've ever gnawed on.
Floating rocks are too unstable for clean loops; heading up to find a solid anchor point above the clouds.
The rope bridge creaked under my feet while I spun; the tea tastes like burnt paper and nothing else matters in this low-poly mess.
